scenes.s1:
Insurance was built on processes.
Then the processes multiplied.
scenes.s2:
More systems. More handoffs.
More complexity.
scenes.s3:
But insurance
doesn't have to work this way.
scenes.s4:
It can move faster. Connect better.
Operate smarter.
scenes.s5:
Technology built for
the next era of insurance.

intro.lead: A connected ecosystem of products, workflows and technology for insurers, brokers, agents, customers and partners.
intro.sub: Modernize distribution. Connect operations. Create better experiences. Move insurance forward.

partners.placeholderNote: Placeholder marks, replace with real partner logos

platform.lead: Insurance now happens everywhere: through brokers, agents, digital platforms, merchants, partners and directly with customers.
platform.problem: But the technology behind these experiences is often fragmented.
platform.build: We build specialized products and technology that bring distribution, customer journeys, operations and servicing into a connected insurance ecosystem.

bento.sub: Specialized products for the people, channels and journeys that power modern insurance.
bento.noteOne: Each Verse solves a distinct challenge.

core.title: Core insurance
core.body: Policy administration, underwriting and product configuration running on a single core.
core.detail: Product definition, rating, policy issue, endorsements and renewals, configured rather than coded.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.body: Broker, agent, partner and direct channels served from the same platform.
distribution.detail: Onboarding, hierarchies, commissions and quoting for every channel you sell through.

journeys.title: Customer journeys
journeys.body: Quote, buy, service and renew, designed as one continuous path.
journeys.detail: Self-service portals and assisted flows working from one view of the customer.

claims.title: Claims
claims.body: Intake, assessment, settlement and recovery, tracked end to end.
claims.detail: First notice of loss through to settlement, with assessment and recovery held in the same file.

payments.title: Payments and finance
payments.body: Collections, disbursements and reconciliation wired into the policy lifecycle.
payments.detail: Premium collection, refunds, payouts and reconciliation against the policy ledger.

data.title: Data and analytics
data.body: Operational and portfolio reporting drawn from live system data.
data.detail: Dashboards and extracts built on the same records the operational system writes.

stack.headlineLine1: Insurance doesn't happen in one system.
stack.headlineLine2: It moves across people, channels, products and moments.

challenge.headline: What do you want to transform?
challenge.subLine1: You don't need to know which technology you need.
challenge.subLine2: Start with the business outcome you're trying to create.

distribution.title: Modernize Distribution
distribution.body: Connect direct, broker, agent and partner channels.

brokerage.title: Transform Brokerage
brokerage.body: Digitize the complete broker journey from prospect to renewal.

agents.title: Empower Agents
agents.body: Give agents better tools to acquire, sell and serve.

customer.title: Reinvent Customer Experience
customer.body: Create simpler digital experiences throughout the insurance lifecycle.

embedded.title: Launch Embedded Insurance
embedded.body: Bring insurance into merchant, marketplace and partner journeys.

claims.title: Transform Claims
claims.body: Connect the claims journey from notification through settlement.
